note: Each entry is verified at build time. Values match scripts/fetch_deps.py; change them there first, then here.

OpenCorePkg.use: bootloader binaries and the matching ocvalidate
OpenCorePkg.why_pinned: ocvalidate only validates configs for its own release; a mismatch produces false errors

1401.use: headless rule engine; vendored Hardware Sniffer and OpCore-Simplify
1401.why_pinned: its knowledge base (efi_rules.json, known_machines.json) is the compatibility brain

ACPICA.use: iasl, the ACPI disassembler OpCore-Simplify needs
ACPICA.why_pinned: 1401 documents that 20251212 segfaults on some DSDTs; 20260408 reads all tested tables

NullMoth NVIDIA.license: PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0 (kexts, plugin); LGPL-3.0-or-later (translator, based on metal2vulkan); MIT (Mesa/NVK changes)
NullMoth NVIDIA.use: Metal driver for Turing-and-newer GeForce cards, installed after macOS boots

OpCore-Simplify.note: 1401's fork carries fixes its engine depends on; prefer it over upstream

apple_media.protocol: session cookie from /, then POST InstallationPayload/RecoveryImage
apple_media.license: Apple software licence; downloaded by the user from Apple, never redistributed here
apple_media.note: Requests use OpenCore macrecovery board selections. The signed image build must match the requested Darwin major.
